name: Chikuden'ya Toubee Hiroku Chigyaku no Yakata
original_name: 逐電屋藤兵衛 秘録恥虐乃館
source:
Matsuo Basho, famous haiku poet is presented here as master ninja of Fuji clan during Edo period. Story focuses on several days of his life.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-june-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
本作把著名俳句诗人松尾芭蕉塑造成江户时代藤氏忍者的首领，故事聚焦于他人生中的数日时光。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-june-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
